bullets.text: Copilot Enhances Text Editing - **Microsoft** Copilot now allows real-time text editing during Vision sessions for seamless collaboration.
Microsoft Store Growth - Over 250 million monthly users enjoyed a more personalized and delightful **Microsoft Store** experience in 2025.
Windows 11 Insider Preview - New **Windows 11** Insider Preview Build introduces Ask Copilot for enhanced productivity on the taskbar.
AI Leadership Recognition - **Microsoft** named a Leader in the 2025 Gartner® Magic Quadrant™ for AI Application Development Platforms.
Unified Security Approach - **Microsoft** advocates for a unified Access Fabric to enhance identity and network access security.
